name: Bator Bai
description: Bator Bai was an ice world located in the Bator Bai system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was linked by a hyperlane to the Kalgo and Suliana systems.
lead_paragraphs: Bator Bai was an ice world located in the Bator Bai system of the Senex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. It was linked by a hyperlane to the Kalgo and Suliana systems.

Bator Bai featured ice cliffs and caverns, the remarkable clarity of which it was known for. Like the other worlds in the Senex-Juvex, it was under the control of the aristocratic Ancient Houses that ruled there.
